title: Baar Baar Dekho
desc: Mathematics professor Jai gets cold feet about marrying his girlfriend Diya. After the marriage is cancelled, he goes on a journey through time, seeing what it would be like if he married Diya.

title: Lingaa
desc: Lingaa, a petty thief, turns over a new leaf after realising the role his grandfather has played in building a dam for the villagers. He then dedicates his life to saving it from a corrupt minister.

title: Saajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder presumes that his first wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he learns that Pooja is alive, he has to juggle between his wives, keeping both his marriages a secret.

title: Jodi No. 1
desc: Two friends, Jai and Veeru, hatch a clever plot to deceive Rai Bahadur and rob him. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when they fall in love with Rai Bahadur's daughters.

title: Big Dhamaka
desc: Two men look alike, with one of them being a successful businessman and the other trying to find work. However, despite their differences, they end up falling for the same woman.
